subject: FIFO #1 XAUUSD/BUY/M1
purpose: Bind same-candidate overlapping-signal admission prospectively before any W10 economic read.
rules: When the candidate is flat, admit the first event in deterministic ordering.
A candidate remains active through and including the admitted trade exit_timestamp.
Reject every later event whose entry_trigger_timestamp is <= the active admitted trade exit_timestamp.
The first event whose entry_trigger_timestamp is strictly greater than the prior active exit_timestamp may be admitted.
Events from different canonical_signal_config_id values are evaluated independently at FIRST_GATE; portfolio-level asset concurrency is downstream and is not inferred here.
An event rejected for overlap is never delayed or re-entered after the active position closes.
Equal-timestamp ambiguity is fail-conservative: no same-candidate re-entry at the exact exit timestamp.
inputs: independently normalized per-event trades under the frozen W09B execution contract
output: deterministic admitted trade set plus deterministic rejected-event ledger
rationale: The W09B contract explicitly left production overlap unbound and fail-closed. This policy is frozen prospectively before W10 and therefore is not selected from economic results.
